description: Fetch an Obsidian-style note scaffold for a document_type so stored memories stay structurally consistent. Returns a markdown template with ## Section headers (e.g., decision → Context/Decision/Consequences; incident → Symptom/Root Cause/Fix/Prevention; also learning, bug-fix, meeting, session). Unknown types get a generic Summary/Details/Notes scaffold (known:false). Read-only: fill the scaffold, then store it via memory_store.

document_type.description: Document type to fetch a note scaffold for (e.g., decision, incident, learning, bug-fix, meeting, session). Unknown types get a generic Summary/Details/Notes scaffold (known:false).

name: memory_template
